compat.text: SikaRoof® VersiScape Panel Reinforced is a safety panel for use with SikaRoof® VersiJack® to provide a raised substructure with the strength and stability to create customisable paver layout designs and act as a safety net in case of accidental paver breakage
compat.heading: DESCRIPTION

compat.text: All holes, joints, and cracks and honeycombs in concrete or masonry surfaces shall be filled with an approved grout and allowed to cure
compat.heading: SUBSTRATE PREPARATION

compat.text: SikaRoof® VersiScape Panel Reinforced shall be loosely laid without any mechanical fixing on top SikaRoof® VersiJack®. For fastened application, the panel may be screwed to the pedestal at allocated pilot screw features with approved screws
compat.heading: APPLICATION
